title: Methods of Construction of Exponential Bases on Planar Domains Revised
summary: In [1], we surveyed classical and recent results on the construction of exponential bases on planar domains with explicit control over the associated frame bounds. We also constructed well-conditioned exponential bases on certain planar sets that multi-tile the plane. In this revision, we identify an error in the choice of basis used in the proof of Theorem 3.11 and we provide a new proof using a simpler exponential basis.
